usageNotes: Use this to discover which QEMU/KVM machine types (q35, i440fx) and specific versioned IDs are available on a given node before creating or migrating a VM. The `arch` parameter is only needed when targeting non-host architectures (e.g., querying aarch64 machine types on an x86_64 host). Results are node-specific — available versions vary by the QEMU package installed on that node.

examples.summary: List all available machine types on node pve1 (host default architecture)

tips: The `id` field (e.g., 'q35-8.1+pve1') is the value to pass as `machine` when creating or updating a VM via qemu endpoints.
Versioned IDs with '+pveX' suffixes include Proxmox-specific patches; the `changes` field describes what those patches add.
If you omit `arch`, the API returns types for the host's native architecture — usually x86_64 on standard Proxmox nodes.
Run this per-node when planning cross-node VM migrations to confirm the destination node supports the same machine type version.
